title: Make a quote that cannot add up wrongly
checks: Rounding is half up to the cent
Quote([QuoteLine('Pens', 3, Money(_D('3.33'), 'USD'))], 15).total() == Money(_D('8.49'), 'USD') and Quote([QuoteLine('Tape', 1, Money(_D('0.25'), 'USD'))], 10).total() == Money(_D('0.23'), 'USD')
Money of different currencies cannot be added
Money cannot be changed after creation
A zero or fractional quantity is rejected
_raises(lambda: QuoteLine('x', 0, Money(_D('1'), 'USD')), ValueError) and _raises(lambda: QuoteLine('x', 1.5, Money(_D('1'), 'USD')), ValueError)
A discount above 30 percent is rejected
Mixed currencies in one quote are rejected
to_dict gives finance the total as text
